The reject option on the TV app does not work. The QR code does not go to your options, as stated, but instead just comes up as 'your options have been saved' - hence falsely claiming you accepted trackers when you've actually been trying to reject them. This remains the worst streaming service.85 people found this review helpfulChannel Five11 November 2024Hello Jenny, I can see your app version is not the latest, please update and try once again. Also please ensure your phone operating system is updated to the latest. Thanks Since the latest update on 16/10/24, the app will load OK. You can ask it to cast to chrome cast but as soon as you start a program the app crashes and shuts down. If you try and reload it, it will keep closing until the program you started to cast finishes. You can delete storage in settings which will allow you to sign in again but if you connect to chrome cast again to control the program it will crash and exit again.58 people found this review helpfulDoesn't remember what you have watched correctly - keeps on marking things I've watched as not watched or not correctly placed. When casting to TV, there is no skip forward backward to allow you to at least find the bit where you have got to accurately and if you stop casting then you have to sit though all the ads AGAIN just to try and find your place.
